inputs.description: The Spec Author's candidate features the Architect t-shirt sizes (planning/feature-proposals.md).

estimates.schema.json — the contract planning/estimates.json is gated against (estimatesConformant). Each entry MUST use the key `feature_id` (NOT `id`) plus a t-shirt `size`; richer fields are allowed. The consumer drops any entry missing feature_id, so conform to this exactly.

outputs.description: The per-candidate t-shirt sizes (XS/S/M/L/XL) the PO commits a sprint-fitting backlog from. estimatesConformant gates the file against estimates.schema.json (each entry carries feature_id + size) AT the turn, so a wrong-key file fails here with a clear error instead of silently emptying the backlog in readEstimates. Sprint-scoped, so NO reconcile. Matches the plain 'estimate' mode only, NOT 'estimate-committed' (which re-syncs the backlog).
